views.reason: Pipeline atlas or preview sheet, not a placed physical object.

generation_parameters.prompt: Create a transparent 6-column x 4-row orthographic pixel-art game asset atlas. Columns exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Rows exactly merchant-stall, mailbox, notice-board, vending-machine matching corresponding supplied source images. Every cell contains one complete, centered object. Preserve exact object identity, proportions, materials, colors, and recognizable decoration from that object's reference. True orthographic directions; top down, bottom underside, rear opposite front. Infer hidden surfaces coherently. No labels, scenery, floor/shadows, perspective, borders or grid marks. Crisp pixel-art, transparent background.

provenance.notes: Unmodified raw generation retained for review and reproducibility.
